source: ElevenLabs launch films (Avatars, Ads Engine, Flows, Speech Engine, Studio 4, Scribe v2, Composer, ElevenMusic, MCP, Dubbing v2, Eleven v3), measured frame by frame at native 30/60 fps with motion_curves.py; see references/motion-lessons.md

motion_blur.measure: translation-dominant frames only, each compared with the resting frames within 0.7 s; whole films read 66-92% (Flows 66, Ads Engine 92, Avatars 92)

container_grow.examples: Dubbing v2 card -> full frame at 6.0 s and 38.9 s; pill -> card at 4.9 s
container_grow.launch: out of the drift: the card is already growing slowly before the move

fullframe_shrink_exit.example: Dubbing v2 full frame -> wall of frames at 29.2 s
fullframe_shrink_exit.then: hard cut; the next scene starts blurred and sharpens over ~0.4 s

reveal.examples: Avatars scatter x0.54 in 0.78s; Composer pull-back x0.38 in 1.23s
reveal.note: EASE_ENTER jumps (x0.84 in one frame); EASE_SETTLE starts too late

laws: accelerate out (EXIT 10-16f), settle in (SETTLE 18-24f), switch at the fastest frame
big scale changes are geometric; entrances pop in linear from 0.6-0.9
never mix two busy images 50/50: pass through a wash, near-black or a duotone
